key_idea: Count assignments directly: choose ordered distinct days for the groups, divide by permutations of equal-sized groups, multiply by the multinomial for assigning people, divide by 365^P - all in log space.
sketch: b = [365!/(365-n)!] / prod(m_k!) * P!/prod(c_i!) / 365^P, where m_k is the number of groups having size k and P = sum c_i. Evaluate with lgamma and convert to log10; O(n). Pitfalls: forgetting the division by m_k! for groups of equal size (sample 1 catches it), and trying to compute the probability itself instead of its logarithm (underflows; P can be 36500). Checked on both samples.
